comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Heh heh! Ahem... "Pruning Shears", "Large scissors used by gardeners". Released in the Second Anniversary Mystery Bottle (11/20). Stats:

Weapon equip (no apparent 'class', so it's sadly incompatible with weapon techs)
100 Durability
5 Attack
10 Disguise
10 Formality
+1 Storage
+1 Ecological Research
+1 Procurement
500 fame to equip, no job class restrictions, but do remember not run with it equipped.

Source: wiki.ogplanet.com/uwo/index.php?title=Second_Anniversary_Mystery_Bottle
